classificationPolicy.secret: Credential, signing or encryption material; never expose in public/client configuration.
classificationPolicy.publicConfig: Non-credential configuration, public key or identifier. This is a classification, not permission to disclose internal identifiers, contacts, allowlists or endpoints.
classificationPolicy.unverified: Missing behavior/provider evidence is explicitly unverified. A template declaration or TypeScript non-null assertion alone does not prove a variable is required, an integration works or a capability passes.

limitations: This is not a whole-repository index, a full environment dependency graph or a deployment-readiness claim.
Only root/scoped example or template names and the requested source roots were considered; root build/mobile/test configuration and tests were not inspected.
JSON files, actual environment files, token/credential stores and provider/account state were excluded.
Dynamic helper arguments, aliases, generated names and inherited environment maps are not exhaustively resolved.
Previously read source paths were excluded from fresh filesystem reads. Available retained excerpts do not guarantee complete environment-reference coverage of those files.
Lexical searching respects ignored files; checked-in status and the current source revision were not independently established.
Requiredness is scoped to the captured caller. Missing key checks, fallback operators and configuration presence do not prove working integrations.
Three template-only names have no captured consumer. Source-only names are not automatically template defects, because many are CI/platform bindings.
No runtime, network, provider, build, test or post-write checks were performed.

documentationFindings.observation: SYNC_TOKEN_KEY is guarded in the encryption loader but a separate signing path uses a literal fallback. Uniform environment policy remains unverified; no code change is made.

CONTACT_CENTER_INBOUND_SECRET is consumed by an authorization path, is absent from the observed example declarations, and has mode-dependent missing-secret behavior. Actual deployment configuration was not inspected.
Some consumers require environment inputs while other helpers prefer stored configuration. This registry does not inspect those stores or declare one global required/optional policy.
